About.title: a little about me
About.headline: I care about the <mark>whole craft</mark>.
paragraphs: I am a 4th-year engineering student at ESIEA, majoring in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science.

Passionate about AI with a solid background in software development. I have built several projects that enabled me to independently design and implement complex software solutions, while strengthening my skills in AI, data analysis, and processing.

brekhtru.blurb: A strategy game with an AI engine (Minimax and heuristics) and several difficulty levels, built in Python.

paymo.blurb: Salary prediction for company employees, built in Python as part of a machine learning course.

atlas.blurb: A multi-store e-commerce platform, built as a team with Next.js and Express.js.

coinex.blurb: A data-driven application built with Python. Explores financial data processing and modeling.

relash.blurb: A Java-based application highlighting object-oriented design and robust architecture.

distro.blurb: A Java application designed to explore distribution and system components.

skedu.blurb: An automation tool that generates personalized timetables, built in Python.

moovi.blurb: An AI agent that recommends movies, built in Python with the Smolagents library.

devix.blurb: A modern storefront for IT equipment, built with HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

qubit.blurb: An AI chatbot specialized in IT topics, built with React.js and Express.js on the OpenAI API.

stockify.blurb: An IT asset management system for universities, built in Java as project lead.
